services.name: Tickets
services.desc: Our Stampede Ticket office is staffed by committed volunteers happy to help you find your perfect spot to enjoy all of the rodeo action at the Williams Lake Stampede. The office is located behind our Grandstand at the Stampede Grounds. Office hours are Monday Friday 9am-5pm. Saturday 10am-4pm Tickets can be purchased at the Grandstand office and through Showpass our only online platform TICKETS.Be aware of 3rd party sellers online reselling tickets for much higher costs. services.name: overnight pen rentals
services.desc: Our pens are available to those that are traveling through and need to give your animals a rest on their journey. Some pens have stock tanks or automatic waterers while others will require you to provide buckets. Water is only available from April to October. All pens must be left clean; wheelbarrows and manure forks

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: While the world-famous Williams Lake Stampede will take place June 25-28 this year, the Weekend still offers plenty to see and do across the region. The annual Stampede Parade is currently being planned. Please check their website and social media channels directly for the latest updates. If you stick around for July The City of Williams Lake hosts Canada Day celebrations at Boitanio Park every July 1. The Museum of the Cariboo Chilcotin, home of the BC Cowboy Hall of Fame, welcomes new inductees during its annual ceremony each Stampede
